name: autocorrelation_regime_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 5-minute rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of 5-second returns quantifies two competing microstructure forces simultaneously present in the index order book. Positive autocorrelation (> 0.20) signals institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing large directional mandates whose resting orders persist across dozens of 5-second bars, creating momentum that lasts 30-90 seconds; we follow the prevailing 1-minute impulse. Negative autocorrelation (< -0.20) signals short-gamma market makers delta-hedging options books dominating the tape — they reflexively fade each 5-second tick with the opposite side, so every 1-minute move becomes self-correcting; we fade back toward VWAP. The 5-second bar resolution lets us classify and react to regime transitions 12× faster than the original 1-minute formulation, entering at the regime's onset rather than after confirmation.
core_signal_oneliner: 5-minute rolling lag-1 autocorrelation of returns classifies regime: positive (>0.20) triggers momentum follow, negative (<-0.20) triggers VWAP mean reversion
